en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Al Husayn Bin Is’haq, from Ali Bin Mahziyar, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from the one who heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying:

‘When the death presented itself to Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, he<sup>asws</sup> wept. So it was said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘O son<sup>asws</sup> of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! You<sup>asws</sup> are weeping and your<sup>asws</sup> status from Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> which you<sup>asws</sup> are with, and he<sup>saww</sup> has said regarding you<sup>asws</sup> what he<sup>saww</sup> said, and you<sup>asws</sup> have performed Hajj twenty Pilgrimages walking, and you<sup>asws</sup> have distributed your<sup>asws</sup> wealth three times, step by step’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But rather, I<sup>asws</sup> weep for two reasons – for the fear of Hereafter (for my<sup>asws</sup> Shias) and the separation from the loved ones’.
